svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Second: architecture
svg.desc: The web app and FastAPI start three Strands graphs (Intake, Daily, Feedback). Each agent is shown with the only tools it is given. Agents reach the DynamoDB store, Google Calendar, Gmail, web search and a Gemini model. The EventBridge, Lambda and AgentCore path is built but not deployed.
svg.text: Solid boxes run today. Only the Daily graph has run on a live model (Gemini, with fake calendar and inbox); Intake and Feedback run in tests with a scripted model. Dashed boxes are built, not deployed.
turns goals you said into a ladder, routes and calendar blocks
each morning: what actually happened, why it slipped, what to do next
what you report back is written into the Living Graph
One audit hook on each graph and every agent. RunawayGuard caps model calls per node. Tool lists are checked when a graph is built.
Conditional edges read typed structured-output fields. Structured output is a forced tool call, so providers that drop it are refused.
ResilientRetry waits the delay a provider asks for, gives up when a daily allowance is gone, and switches model when a refusal names it.
